title: Rule-UI-Theme
description: JSON schema for a Pega Theme rule instance (Rule-UI-Theme). A theme defines the Constellation/Cosmos design-token set (base tokens and per-component overrides) consumed at runtime. Only authored and identity fields are included; system-managed runtime and provenance fields are intentionally omitted. This describes a named theme instance (e.g. 'pzAuriga'), not the RULE-OBJ-CLASS RULE-UI-THEME class-definition record (a platform-owned artifact that application teams do not author).

pyRuleName.description: Internal name of the theme instance, e.g. 'pzAuriga'. Also used (upper-cased) as pxInsName and as the token in the instance key: 'RULE-UI-THEME <PYRULENAME> #<timestamp>'.
The authored class key for the theme rule.

pyLabel.description: Human-readable display label shown in App Studio's theme picker, e.g. 'Auriga (2026)'.

pyDescription.description: Developer-facing description of the theme's purpose or brand.

pyIsOTBTheme.description: Present and 'true' only on OOTB-shipped themes. Omit for app-authored themes; do not set this on a custom theme.

pyDefinition.description: The most important field on this rule. A JSON-encoded object with two confirmed top-level sections: 'base' (global tokens — colors, palette, typography, spacing, hit-area, shadow, z-index, breakpoints, etc.) and 'components' (per-component overrides, e.g. button, card, table, app-shell, form-control). Two value shapes are confirmed: a flat literal shape (raw values) and a richer shape where every leaf is {$type: 'literal'|'inherited', $value: ...} — 'inherited' means an alias to another dot-path token. Always fetch the current value with get-rule(detail="full") before update, detect which shape is present, and merge changes into it in that same shape — never replace it with a partial or empty value, never convert between shapes, and never invent sub-keys beyond those confirmed against a live instance. See references/theme-definition-token-inventory.md for the confirmed key list.

pyRuleSet.description: Ruleset for the current instance. OOTB themes resolve in Pega-UIEngine; a new or branched theme should resolve in the active application/branch ruleset.

pyRuleSetName.description: Ruleset name for the current instance. Do not treat this as a fixed constant across live and branched copies.

pyRuleAvailable.description: Availability status. Observed as 'Final' on a shipped OOTB theme.
